## 4. Whole audit of the new local algebra and principal symbol

**Section2: both injections and monic weak division.** Let Aalg be the integral localization written with generators r,u,v and relations uf=1,vq=1. At0, f(0)=1,q(0)=-1 are p-adic units; the integral expansions define a map of its separated p-completion to O[[r]]. If an image vanishes, its reduction forces the source into p Ahat; dividing by p is legitimate because the targets are p-torsion-free. Iterating and using separation kills the source. The common-annulus differential restriction is correctly distinguished from the bare completion map. Derivatives respect that convergence, and the bounded/Robba maps have common Laurent coefficients.
